verdict.rationale: The first-party docs only show that the Drive API can list all of a user's files and folders. The actual 'export everything in open formats' workflow is evidenced by community reports of the third-party tool rclone, which can pull all Drive content and export Google Docs to ODF. Community reports also note friction: the sync client leaves native Docs as URL stubs, and large downloads are delayed by virus checks. Missing for 10: any first-party bulk export feature or documentation (e.g. an account-wide export tool), first-party documentation of open-format conversion for native Docs/Sheets/Slides, and evidence of a complete, reliable export without third-party tools.
